scope: Read-only repository and primary-source research; public SDK/model artifact inspection. No inference, account login, gated download, license acceptance, source edit, or remote embedding performed.
decision: Implement a dedicated local MemoryEmbedder using the official EmbeddingGemma .task bundle with pinned com.google.mediapipe:tasks-text:1.0.0. Current Google Android docs explicitly support this bundle; do not load arbitrary raw EmbeddingGemma .tflite files in TextEmbedder. Retain a working, explicitly reported lexical-only mode whenever installation, validation, runtime, privacy qualification, or index coverage is unavailable.

artifact.format: ZIP task bundle: gemma.tflite, manifest.pb, sentencepiece.model

hf_equivalent.evidence: Public HF API LFS SHA256 matches embedded gemma.tflite exactly. HF weights access remains gated; no HF gate accepted.

artifact.model_sha_evidence: Calculated over complete generation-pinned public Google download. GCS ETag is not substituted for SHA256.

sdk.evidence: Official Google Maven metadata, POM, downloaded classes.jar and v1.0.0 Java source checked. Not inferred from latest.release.
sdk.doc_error: Android guide snippet uses TextFormatContext.EmbeddingType. Actual 1.0.0 AAR/source declares TextEmbedder.EmbeddingType; TextFormatContext and TextRole are also nested inside TextEmbedder.
sdk.normalization: CreateFromFile defaults quantize=false,l2Normalize=false. Bundle already performs pooling, dense projections, normalization: do not mean-pool returned vectors or prepend prompt twice. Validate 768 finite floats and nonzero norm. If storing 256/512/128 MRL dimensions, take first d values and L2 re-normalize, and record d in index identity. Prefer full 768 for first measured baseline.
sdk.tokenization: Bundled SentencePiece tokenizer. v1.0.0 GeckoPreprocessorCalculator encodes formatted text, requires token_ids.size()+2 <= max_seq_len, then adds BOS and EOS and pads with tokenizer pad_id. With this artifact, at most 510 formatted-text tokens plus BOS/EOS = 512. Overlong input raises an error (despite defensive truncation inside GetPaddedTokens); do not rely on silent truncation. Query/document prefixes count toward capacity. Split/bound chunks with actual tokenizer or handle overlength as explicit unavailable/rechunk outcome. Upstream architecture maximum 2048 is not this artifact capacity.
sdk.pooling_evidence: Static TFLite tail includes masked sum/division, two FULLY_CONNECTED ops, squared norm/reduction/epsilon/rsqrt/multiply producing [1,768]. This is static artifact inspection, not numerical runtime verification.
sdk.privacy: Official notice states input text stays on device but performance/utilization metrics go to Google. Do not claim no network behavior. No supported telemetry opt-out verified here. Audit released binary/manifest and privacy requirements before enabling; consider isolated no-network process or a reviewed telemetry-free source build if strict no-egress is required. Merely excluding transport dependencies is not established safe and may break runtime.

repo.found: The requested names ModelDownloadManager/LocalModelRuntime do not exist in this checkout. Actual equivalents are ModelDownloader, ModelStore, LocalModelEngine and LiteRtLmEngine.
repo.integration: LocalModelEngine is text generation only; add separate embedding runtime rather than switching the selected chat model. Reuse resumable transfer and SHA256 helpers via an embedding-specific store/catalog. ModelStore generic explicit import permits arbitrary hashes after native chat smoke tests: do not reuse that acceptance rule for embedding identity. Require exact pinned SHA and size before installation. Retain separate model lifecycle and indexed-document generation.
repo.runtime: Serialize embedder creation/embed/close on an off-main worker. Coordinate foreground voice/chat priority and power/unload policy. Native synchronous inference cannot be assumed cancelled by coroutine timeout; do not race close with active inference. Reject stale results after mutation, erase, expiry, lock or model/index identity change.
repo.index: Persist rebuildable vectors with model SHA, tokenizer SHA, dimension, prompt version, source/chunk ID and canonical record revision. On identity mismatch rebuild. Apply policy/sensitivity/deletion/expiry fences before candidate retrieval and again before delivery. Hybrid ranking must preserve lexical results while semantic index builds.
repo.install: Use explicit on-device acquisition/import, atomic temp-file verification/install, exact pinned digest and size, storage/progress/error UI. Download should contain no memory/query content. Never automatically accept a gated license.
repo.fallback: Return explicit availability such as NOT_INSTALLED, INDEX_BUILDING, READY, FAILED and lexicalOnly status; keep approved eligible keyword retrieval functional. Do not produce hash-based pseudo-embeddings or label fixture-generated vectors as real EmbeddingGemma coverage.
repo.packaging: Resolve and inspect JNI/dependency conflicts with existing LiteRT-LM and Sherpa setup. Repository already handles duplicate ONNX library symbols; do not add ONNX fallback without renewed native compatibility work.
